Death Probabilities to Mortality Rates

Source: R/3_demographicFunctions.R
qx2mx.Rd

Function to convert death probabilities to mortality rates

Usage

qx2mx(qx, ax = 0.5)

Arguments

qx

death probabilities

ax

the average number of years lived between ages x and x +1 by individuals who die in that interval

Value

A vector of mortality rates

Details

Function to convert death probabilities to mortality rates

See also

mxt, qxt, mx2qx

Examples

data(soa08Act)
soa08qx<-as(soa08Act,"numeric")
soa08mx<-qx2mx(qx=soa08qx)
soa08qx2<-mx2qx(soa08mx)
